errors.evidence: The description states the x-axis has a linear scale, but the intervals between tick values (64, 128, 256, 512, 768) are not uniform (64, 128, 256, 256). The scale is non-linear.

The data point for x=128 has a y-value slightly above the 0.748 grid line, but clearly below the midpoint to the 0.750 grid line. A value of 0.749 is an overestimation; the value is approximately 0.7485.
The data point for x=256 has a y-value that is exactly on the 0.754 grid line. The stated value of 0.754 is incorrect; the value in the plot at x=256 is 0.754.
The description fails to mention the empty legend box present in the top-right corner of the plot.
